hunks.baseline: The valley was narrow and dark. Ancient trees of unknowable age grew thickly enough to block out the moonlight, while strange plants and creatures I had never seen before covered every direction.
hunks.sol: The valley was narrow and dark. Trees too old for me to guess their age grew thick enough to block the moonlight, and strange plants and creatures I had never seen before filled the space around me.

hunks.baseline: And some of them were quite aggressive.
hunks.sol: Some of them were aggressive, too.

hunks.baseline: I was using my movement technique when I suddenly reached out. Something that had shot up from the grass like lightning writhed in my grip.
hunks.sol: I was moving with my movement technique when I reached out. Something shot from the grass like lightning and writhed in my grip.

hunks.baseline: *Crackle. Crackle!*
hunks.sol: *Chrit. Chrit!*

hunks.baseline: After taking a closer look, I realized I was only half right.
hunks.sol: A closer look told me I was half right.

hunks.baseline: It was a snake, but not an ordinary one. The horns growing from either side of its triangular head were proof enough.
hunks.sol: It was a snake, but no ordinary one. Horns grew from either side of its triangular head.

hunks.baseline: I stared intently at the snake and muttered under my breath.
“Mimi… No, a Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake?”
hunks.sol: I stared at it and muttered, “Mimi… No, a Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake?”

hunks.baseline: *Crackle.*
hunks.sol: *Chrit.*

hunks.baseline: Why was this thing here? Wasn’t the Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake supposed to be one of the rarest venomous creatures in the world?
hunks.sol: Why was one here? Wasn’t the Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake supposed to be rare even across the whole world?

hunks.baseline: *Now that I look at it again, it seems a little different.*
hunks.sol: *Now that I look again, it does seem a little different.*

hunks.baseline: *Is it because this is basically China? There are knockoffs everywhere.*
hunks.sol: Maybe it was because this place was basically China. Knockoffs everywhere.

hunks.baseline: Compared to Mimi, its body was larger, but its sheen and horns were inferior.
hunks.sol: Compared to Mimi, its body was larger, but its sheen and horns were less impressive.

hunks.baseline: I stared at the snake in my hand with disbelief, then threw it into the distance and picked up speed. Whether it really was a Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake or not, one thing seemed certain: just as I had guessed, this valley was not a safe place.
hunks.sol: I stared at the snake in disbelief, then threw it into the distance and picked up speed. Whether it was a Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake or not, I had been right about one thing: this valley was not safe.

hunks.baseline: *Just as I thought. Is this a trap?*
hunks.sol: *Is it a trap after all?*

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because I had wasted a short amount of time before entering, the Black Tiger and the Beast Miao King were already far ahead.
hunks.sol: I had spent a little time before entering, and the Black Tiger and the Beast Miao King were already far ahead. At least the Beast Miao King had left tracks here and there. The Black Tiger had left none, as though it really were a wraith.

hunks.baseline: The one fortunate thing was that, unlike the Black Tiger—which left no footprints, as though it really were a wraith—the Beast Miao King’s tracks remained here and there.

hunks.baseline: After running like that for about seven minutes, I spotted a vast swamp drawing closer in the distance, along with a familiar back standing at its center.
hunks.sol: After running for about half a gak, I spotted a vast swamp drawing closer in the distance. A familiar figure stood at its center.

hunks.baseline: I shouted.
“……I had already stopped.”
hunks.sol: “…I’ve already stopped.”

hunks.baseline: The Beast Miao King was telling the truth. His face was still twisted with anger, but he was standing perfectly still, with the corpses of venomous creatures and ferocious beasts scattered around him.
hunks.sol: He had. The Beast Miao King still looked furious, but he stood perfectly still amid the bodies of venomous beasts and ferocious animals.

hunks.baseline: “They suddenly attacked from every direction like mad. I lost sight of it because of them.”
hunks.sol: “They came at me from every direction like mad things. I lost sight of it because of them.”

hunks.baseline: Humans and beasts alike knew better than to recklessly attack someone stronger than themselves. If anything, beasts with sharper instincts were even more cautious.
hunks.sol: Humans and beasts alike knew better than to attack someone stronger without good reason. If anything, beasts were more cautious because their instincts were sharper.

hunks.baseline: And yet, they had still blocked the Beast Miao King’s path.
hunks.sol: Yet these creatures had blocked the Beast Miao King’s path.

hunks.baseline: “Could it have been for that creature’s sake?”
hunks.sol: “Were they doing it for the Black Tiger?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. But whatever the reason, it isn’t strange. This land has always been like this. It was probably the same a hundred years ago, and two hundred years ago.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know. But whatever their reason, it isn’t strange. This land has always been like this. It was probably the same a hundred years ago. Two hundred, too.”

hunks.baseline: It was a strange answer. He sounded as if he had known about this place from the beginning.
hunks.sol: That was an odd answer. He sounded as though he had known about this place all along.

hunks.baseline: When I gave him a questioning look, the Beast Miao King continued with a stern expression.
hunks.sol: When I gave him a questioning look, he continued, his expression hard.

hunks.baseline: Poison was scorned everywhere, but in truth, it was one of the most efficient weapons in existence.

That was even more true from the Five Poisons Sect’s perspective. They had turned all of Nanman except themselves into enemies and had to fight opponents who outnumbered them by at least dozens of times.
hunks.sol: Poison was scorned everywhere, but it was an efficient weapon. Especially for the Five Poisons Sect. They had made enemies of everyone else in Nanman and faced opponents who outnumbered them dozens of times over.

hunks.baseline: “The place they created for that purpose was called the Poisonblood Grounds.[^1] A place where the most savage and vicious beasts and venomous creatures in all of Nanman—and even the entire world—ran rampant. The most lethal yet secret legacy left behind by the Five Poisons Sect.”
hunks.sol: “The place they created was called the Poisonblood Grounds. The most savage and vicious beasts and venomous creatures in all Nanman—perhaps in the entire world—ran rampant there. It was the deadliest and most secret legacy the Five Poisons Sect left behind.”

hunks.baseline: “Then does that mean this is…”
hunks.sol: “Are you saying this is…”

hunks.baseline: The Beast Miao King gave a small nod.
hunks.sol: The Beast Miao King nodded.

hunks.baseline: “This is the Poisonblood Grounds.”
hunks.sol: “The Poisonblood Grounds.”

hunks.baseline: “Huh. No wonder there wasn’t even a path. But it doesn’t seem as dangerous as you made it sound. I can still breathe.”
hunks.sol: “Huh. No wonder there wasn’t a path. But it doesn’t seem as dangerous as you made it sound. I can still breathe.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, I had encountered a knockoff Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake on the way here, and poisonous air had seeped into me like carbonation with every breath in and out, but I had been more or less fine so far.
hunks.sol: Granted, I had met a knockoff Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake on the way, and poisonous air seeped into me like carbonation with every breath. So far, though, I was doing all right.

hunks.baseline: That changed after I heard the Beast Miao King’s next words.
hunks.sol: Then the Beast Miao King spoke again.

hunks.baseline: “It would be. We are only in the outskirts of the Poisonblood Grounds. This is barely the entrance.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. We’re on the outskirts of the Poisonblood Grounds. This is only the entrance.”

hunks.baseline: “According to the records, around a hundred years ago, only the finest elites from each Nanman tribe were selected to enter the Poisonblood Grounds. They carried hundreds of jars filled with lamp oil and held poison-warding pearls in their mouths. What do you think happened?”
hunks.sol: “According to the records, a little over a hundred years ago, each tribe in Nanman selected only its finest warriors to enter the Poisonblood Grounds. They carried hundreds of jars filled with lamp oil and held poison-warding pearls in their mouths. What do you think happened?”

hunks.baseline: “I doubt they all returned safely and lived happily ever after.”
hunks.sol: “I’m guessing they didn’t all come home safely and live happily ever after.”

hunks.baseline: “Not a single person returned. Everything came to nothing after that, and it is the main reason Ailao Mountain has remained a forbidden land to this day.”
hunks.sol: “Not one returned. The whole undertaking came to nothing. It is the chief reason Ailao Mountain remains forbidden to this day.”

hunks.baseline: I followed the direction of the Beast Miao King’s pointing finger and saw a massive swamp stretching for hundreds of zhang.
hunks.sol: I followed his pointing finger to a huge swamp that stretched for hundreds of zhang. Mist hung over it.

hunks.baseline: I gazed blankly at the mist resting over it, then cautiously opened my mouth.
“By the way, is the fog around here usually green?”
hunks.sol: “By the way,” I asked cautiously, “is the fog around here usually green?”

hunks.baseline: “That one is green.”
hunks.sol: “That fog is green.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah. That is because it is poisonous mist.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. That is because it’s Poison Mist.”

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I was thrown off by how naturally he said it, as casually as a mother announcing, “We’re having soybean-paste stew for dinner tonight.” I forced myself to remain calm and asked,
hunks.sol: He said it as casually as a mother announcing that dinner was soybean-paste stew. I took a moment to collect myself.

hunks.baseline: “……Where exactly have you brought me?”
hunks.sol: “…Where exactly have you brought me?”

hunks.baseline: At my utterly disbelieving stare, the Beast Miao King smacked his lips.
hunks.sol: The Beast Miao King smacked his lips at my stare.

hunks.baseline: “I only found out after entering. The records did not state the exact location of the Poisonblood Grounds.”
hunks.sol: “I didn’t know until we came in. Even the records didn’t give the Poisonblood Grounds’ exact location.”

hunks.baseline: It was a goddamn mess. As I wondered whether White Tiger could bring the others this far, I asked,
hunks.sol: This was a goddamn mess. Wondering whether White Tiger could lead the others this far, I asked, “Then what’s deeper inside?”

hunks.baseline: “Then what is deeper inside?”
“Baeksang’s grandfather, who had been the Palace Lord of this Palace at the time, also died there. I heard he was the strongest warrior in the history of the Bai people.”
hunks.sol: “Baeksang’s grandfather died there, too. He was Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace at the time. I’ve heard he was the strongest warrior in the history of the Bai people.”

hunks.baseline: The position of Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace was not passed down through a single family in an entirely hereditary succession.

hunks.baseline: Yayul Mok was only the nominal Young Palace Lord. If the position of Palace Lord became vacant, a tribal council would be held, and one of the great chieftains from the four most powerful tribes would be elected as Palace Lord by vote.
hunks.sol: The Palace Lord’s position did not pass down through a single family. Yayul Mok was only the nominal Young Palace Lord. If the position became vacant, the Tribal Grand Council would convene, and one of the great chieftains of the four most powerful tribes would be elected Palace Lord.

hunks.baseline: “Was he stronger than Great Hero Yayul?”
hunks.sol: “Stronger than you, Great Hero Yayul?”

hunks.baseline: “That is impossible to know. The standards for strength are always changing. But if he had lived in the same era as me, it would not have been strange for there to be a Beast Bai King instead of a Beast Miao King.”
hunks.sol: “I cannot say. The measure of strength changes with the times. But had he lived in my era, I would not be surprised if we had a Beast Bai King instead of a Beast Miao King.”

hunks.baseline: Judging by how highly the Beast Miao King spoke of him, Baeksang’s grandfather had clearly been at least a Supreme Peak master by Central Plains standards—someone who had opened the Middle Dantian, if not gone beyond that.
hunks.sol: For the Beast Miao King to speak of him like that, Baeksang’s grandfather must have been at least a Supreme Peak master by Central Plains standards—someone who had opened the Middle Dantian, or gone beyond it.

hunks.baseline: *The problem is that a master of that level was wiped out in the Poisonblood Grounds alongside Nanman’s elite warriors.*
hunks.sol: *And a master like that died in the Poisonblood Grounds alongside Nanman’s finest warriors.*

hunks.baseline: *And the even bigger problem is that I have to go in there now.*
hunks.sol: The bigger problem was that I had to go in there now.

hunks.baseline: But still…
hunks.sol: Still…

hunks.baseline: “We’ve come all this way. We can’t turn back now. Let’s go.”
hunks.sol: “We’ve come this far. We can’t turn back now. Let’s go.”

hunks.baseline: At my calm declaration, the Beast Miao King looked surprised.
hunks.sol: The Beast Miao King looked surprised by how calmly I said it.

hunks.baseline: “That is unexpected. I thought you would suggest turning back.”
hunks.sol: “I thought you would suggest turning back.”

hunks.baseline: “……Who said that?”
hunks.sol: “…Who said that?”

hunks.baseline: The Beast Miao King stared at me with a dubious expression, then broke into a grin.
hunks.sol: He gave me a dubious look, then grinned.

hunks.sol: Bones ground in his tightly clenched fist. His voice turned cold.

hunks.sol: “I am the great chieftain of the Miao people, but I am also Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace. I must make someone pay for their blood.”

hunks.baseline: Perhaps this was why he had been able to become the Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace.

hunks.sol: “What else could I do? People died. I couldn’t leave you here alone and go back.”

hunks.baseline: “Even if there were no Dark Heaven inside, would you still do it?”
hunks.sol: “Even if Dark Heaven isn’t in there?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not such a coward.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not that much of a coward.”

hunks.baseline: A faint smile formed at the corner of the Beast Miao King’s mouth.
hunks.sol: A faint smile touched his lips.

hunks.baseline: “I have heard that people in the Central Plains call men like you chivalrous heroes.”
hunks.sol: “I hear the Central Plains calls men like you chivalrous heroes.”

hunks.baseline: “People who dislike me usually call me a fucking bastard. I mostly get called a lunatic.”
hunks.sol: “People who dislike me usually call me a fucking bastard. I get called a lunatic a lot, too.”

hunks.baseline: Those were undeniable facts, so I was not offended. Besides, most of the people who had called me those things had died by my hand.
hunks.sol: It was true, so I wasn’t offended. Besides, most of the people who had called me those things had died by my hand. People really ought to watch what they say.

hunks.baseline: That was why people always had to watch their mouths.
I still did not know whether I was truly one.
I had simply ended up here after starting something, and somehow people had begun calling me that.
hunks.sol: I still didn’t know if I was one. I had done one thing, then another, and somehow ended up here with people calling me that.

hunks.baseline: *A chivalrous hero in the Central Plains. A hero in the modern world.*

hunks.baseline: *Fine. Let’s face it. Whatever is in there.*
hunks.sol: *Fine. Let’s take on whatever’s in there.*

hunks.baseline: I might not have had a chance alone, but with the Beast Miao King beside me, we had a chance—even if the Southern Heaven Demon Empress herself was waiting inside.
hunks.sol: Alone, I might have had reason to worry. With the Beast Miao King beside me, we had a chance even if the Southern Heaven Demon Empress was waiting inside.
